items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, J.C. Heard used to be a boyfriend of mine.

ctx.x: One thing I’m unsure of from the liner notes and articles—I believe, did Jo Jones or J.C. Heard ever play in your trio’s?
Yeah, J.C. Heard used to be a boyfriend of mine.
When was this? J.C. Heard? Tell me about him.
